d:
Step into the romantic charm of 1980s Bollywood with “Chal Chameli Baag Mein” from the film Krodhi (1981)! Featuring Sachin and Ranjeeta and beautifully sung by the legendary Lata Mangeshkar and Suresh Wadkar, with music composed by Laxmikant–Pyarelal, this melodious song brings back the nostalgic magic of classic Hindi cinema.
Chal Chameli Baag Mein | Krodhi | Sachin, Ranjeeta | Lata Mangeshkar, Suresh Wadkar | 80s Love Song
Song: Chal Chameli Baag Mein
Movie: Krodhi (1981)
Star Cast: Sachin Pilgaonkar, Ranjeeta Kaur
Singers: Lata Mangeshkar, Suresh Wadkar
Music Director: Laxmikant Pyarelal
